maṭṭha: [Masa+ta] (pu,na) CL=7 Masa+ta[Masa āmasane vijjhane ca. Masīyitthāti maṭṭho. Nirutti, nhā. 492.(maṭa-saṃ)] (Pu) (1) Beating. poking (or) jabbing. (Na) (2) A hole. (Ti) (3) Should be beaten and poked. (4) Smooth.
maṭṭhabhāva: [Maṭṭha+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 A state of being well-prepared. Smooth. See - Maṭṭhabhāvattha.
maṭṭhachavivaṇṇa: [Maṭṭha+chavivaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who has a smooth complexion.
maṭṭhadaṇḍaka: [Maṭṭha+daṇḍaka] (pu,na) CL=7 A small and smooth stick. See - Jatumaṭṭhaka.
maṭṭhadukūla: [Maṭṭha+dukūla] (pu,na) CL=7 A soft and fine cloth. See - Dukūla.
maṭṭhadussa: [Maṭṭha+dussa] (na) CL=7 A soft and fine cloth.
maṭṭhakamma: [Maṭṭha+kamma] (na) CL=7 The affair of doing well-prepared.
maṭṭhakapaṭṭikā: [Maṭṭhakā+paṭṭikā] (thī) CL=7 (1) A smooth plate. (Ti) (2) The shape of a smooth plate. See - Paṭṭikā.
maṭṭhakasāṭaka: [Maṭṭhaka+sāṭaka] (na) CL=7 A fine cloth (lower garment of a man) (a good and strengthened cloth. Jātaka).
maṭṭhakañcanapaṭṭa: [Maṭṭha+kañcanapaṭṭa] (pu,na) CL=7 Smooth and fine gold plate.
maṭṭhakuṇḍalivaṇṇa: [Maṭṭhakuṇḍalī+vaṇṇa] (pu) CL=7 The appearance of a young man named Maṭṭhakuṇḍalī.
maṭṭhakuṇḍalī: [Maṭṭha+kuṇḍalī] (ti) CL=7 A person named Maṭṭhakuṇḍalī who is wearing beautiful earrings.
maṭṭhakuṇḍalīmāṇava: [Maṭṭhakuṇḍalī+māṇava] (pu) CL=7 A young man named Maṭṭhakuṇḍalī.
maṭṭhakuṇḍalīrūpa: [Maṭṭhakuṇḍalī+rūpa] (na) CL=7 The appearance that is like  Maṭṭhakuṇḍalī young man.
maṭṭhakuṇḍalīvimāna: [Maṭṭhakuṇḍalī+vimāna] (pu,na) CL=7 The story that explains Maṭṭhakuṇḍalī"s mansion. Maṭṭhakuṇḍalīvimāna story.
maṭṭhapaṭṭikā: [Maṭṭhā+paṭṭikā] (thī) CL=7 (1) Fine plate. (T) (2) The appearance of a smooth plate.
maṭṭharathaṅga: [Maṭṭha+rathaṅga] (na) CL=7 (1) Good parts of a coach. (Ti) (2) Like the good part of a coach.
maṭṭhasāṭaka: [Maṭṭha+sāṭaka] (pu) CL=7 A soft and fine cloth.
maṭṭhasāṭakanivattha: [Maṭṭhasāṭaka+nivattha] (ti) CL=7 One who is wearing a soft lower cloth.
maṭṭhavacana: [Maṭṭha+vacana] (na) CL=7 (1) Good words (sound). (Ti) (2) One who is speaking good words.
maṭṭhavācā: [Maṭṭhā+vācā] (ti) CL=7 One who is speaking gentle words (sound).
maṭṭhayuga: [Maṭṭha+yuga] (na) CL=7 A set of fine and soft lower clothes.
